title: Echoing Archive
description: A librarian can transcribe a card from your expedition deck.

options.title: Copy a card
options.description: Make one copy, including any training.

options.title: Take 2 Emeralds
options.description: Keep the supplies for the next villager.

options.title: Pass by
options.description: Continue along the trail.

title: Abandoned Forge
description: There is enough heat left to reforge one card.

options.title: Work the bellows
options.description: Spend 3 Health to train one untrained card.

options.title: Melt a card
options.description: Remove one copy from the expedition deck.

options.title: Pass by
options.description: Continue along the trail.

title: Wandering Collector
description: Swap an unwanted card for a choice from the collector's stock.

options.title: Exchange a card
options.description: Choose a card to trade for one of three other cards.

options.title: Take 2 Emeralds
options.description: Keep the supplies for the next villager.

options.title: Pass by
options.description: Continue along the trail.

title: The Sunken Apiary
description: A beekeeper has one jar of honey left. The broken hives still hold enough comb to trade.

options.title: Buy the honey
options.description: Pay 2 Emeralds to recover 7 Health.

options.title: Reach into the hive
options.description: Lose 3 Health and collect 4 Emeralds.

options.title: Pass by
options.description: Keep walking.

title: The Last Minecart
description: A supply cart is stuck on a broken rail. Its chest and its cargo are too heavy to carry together.

options.title: Open the chest
options.description: Choose one borrowed card to add to your deck.

options.title: Sell the cargo
options.description: Gain 3 Emeralds for the next village.

options.title: Pass by
options.description: Keep walking.

title: The Singing Geode
description: Deep inside the amethyst, a single note rings back every time your pick strikes.

options.title: Leave an echo
options.description: Pay 3 Emeralds to duplicate a card, including its training.

options.title: Chip out a charm
options.description: Lose 4 Health and choose a charm.

options.title: Pass by
options.description: Keep walking.

title: The Ruined Portal
description: A cartographer wants a rubbing of the portal runes. Beyond the arch you can hear boots on blackstone.

options.title: Step through
options.description: Lose 5 Health and gain 1 starting XP for every remaining fight.

options.title: Trace the runes
options.description: Recover 3 Health and earn 1 Emerald.

options.title: Pass by
options.description: Keep walking.
